tools.name: list_color_seasons
tools.description: Lists the 12 seasons of seasonal color analysis with a one-line description of each. Use it to explain the system or help someone narrow down their season.

tools.name: get_season_palette
tools.description: Returns a season's 12 best colors (names and hex codes), 4 colors to avoid, best metals and a description, plus a link to ColorSnapAI's free photo analysis.

tools.name: estimate_color_season
tools.description: Gives a rough estimate of someone's color season from the hex colors of their natural hair, skin (cheek) and eyes (iris), with a runner-up when it's close. Returns the estimated season, its palette and a link to ColorSnapAI's free photo analysis, which measures the face directly and is more accurate
